name: Kouda Miyoko
source:
The protagonist's grandmother. As a child the protagonist was taken care of by his grandmother due to his parents being busy. In the current time, his grandmother and grandfather passed away, leaving him heart broken. Due to unknown reasons, he travels back in time to where his grandmother is still alive and decided to spend more time with her. For reasons he doesn't understand, his grandmother does naughty things to him.

[spoiler] In reality, it was a dream. He woke up on the day of his grandmother's death realizing that his grandmother was his first love.[spoiler]
